Photo Editor AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit, retouch, and enhance photos via plain-language requests.
- Supports background removal, color correction, portrait retouching, creative filters, and more.
- Automatic connection and authentication with 100 free edits for new users.
- Edits routed to AI pipelines based on user intent for fast, context-aware results.
- Secure, cloud-based image processing with high-res export (jpg, png, mp4, etc.).
- Clear handling for uploads, exports, credits, and errors — plus responsive progress updates.
